regions.breakdown: This inscription is in Low German (Plattdeutsch), a regional dialect. 'Uns to Ihrem Angedenken' translates to 'To your memory' (High German: 'Euch zum Andenken'). 'Dei Stralendörper Dorp un Hof' means 'The village and farms of Stralendorf' (High German: 'Die Stralendorfer Dorf und Hof'). It commemorates those from Stralendorf who died between 1914 and 1918 (World War I).

where_youd_see_it: You would see this war memorial and street signs in a small German town or village square.
cultural_note: War memorials listing local fallen soldiers from World War I and II are common in German towns. Many older memorials, especially in northern Germany, feature dialectal inscriptions like this one from Low German (Plattdeutsch), reflecting local identity.
